body:
Closed the recurring bug class flagged in the previous Apple (#16514): the Windows cross-compile step's -include/.c mod list drifted out of sync with scripts/build.sh FOUR times in a row (bloodflower, tree_passive, card_effect, combat_log mods). Replaced the hand-maintained list with a real glob over packages/simulation/*_mod_host.h and *_mod.c. Verified with a real local x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc compile+link against the exact SDL2-devel-2.30.10-mingw package CI downloads -- produces a real 684KB ECOWAR.exe. CI green, run 33137399328. ECOWAR commit 0bc8fd7.

⚓ ☃
title: Structural CI fix: glob the Windows mod list instead of hardcoding it
